laiDetails.initiationProtocol: Test dose 12.5 mg deep gluteal IM; observe for 4-7 days. Maintenance 12.5-50 mg every 2-4 weeks (range up to 100 mg every 2-4 weeks). Higher EPS risk than thioxanthene depots — counsel patient about dystonia, akathisia.

halfLife.notes: Effective half-life ~10 days — shorter than thioxanthene depots, allowing closer titration. Steady state in ~6 weeks. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: CYP2D6 inhibitors raise levels and worsen EPS. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

lai.notes: This entry IS the LAI. Long-established but EPS burden has reduced first-line use in modern practice.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Tardive dyskinesia after long-term use is the main concern. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Oily solution (sesame oil vehicle). Deep gluteal IM. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
